name: Gate
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You conjure a portal within medium range that leads to any other location. The location can be a place you can see or describe. Roll Lore. If you cannot see the location, the roll is ill-favored. Either way, the result is the maximum diameter of the portal, in feet.

You can see through the portal to the linked location from either side. A creature that passes through the portal is immediately transported to the linked location.

Describe the gate.
successes:
✨: You may sustain the portal for up to 1 additional minute.

🌞: You may choose to make the portal persist until dispelled.

💀: The portal's surface is a confusion of swirling energy and its destination is uncertain. Check a Condition. Each time a creature passes through the portal, roll a d8. On an 8, they pass through without being transported. On a 2-7, they are transported to a random location, chosen by the GM. On a 1, the creature is transported to the place of your birth.
